name: Vamsi's guided strategy

account.holder_profile: US retail investor; every trade follows Vamsi's direction
account.type: Individual cash account with options and crypto (no margin: FINRA requires $2,000 of equity)
account.broker_model: US zero-commission broker with stocks, options and crypto in one account
account.settlement: T+1 for stocks and options; crypto settles instantly

execution_model.fill: Latest trade price from Yahoo Finance at execution time (regular or extended-hours print), adjusted for slippage
execution_model.sessions: Stocks/ETFs: pre-market 4:00-9:30, regular 9:30-16:00, after-hours 16:00-20:00 ET. Options: regular session only. Crypto: 24/7.

options.fill: Ask to buy, bid to sell (Yahoo Finance option chain)

crypto.fill: Last trade plus/minus the broker spread

allowed_instruments: Listed options (buy calls and puts, covered calls, cash-secured puts)
blocked_lists: OFAC NS-CMIC (EO 14032) Chinese military-industrial complex securities
rules.note: Trades only on Vamsi's instructions: he says where to look and how to trade; Claude executes through trade.py, logs every order and applies the stops and exits he sets. Cash account, no margin (FINRA's $2,000 minimum), so no short selling or naked option writing. The only book since Sat Oct 3, when the H-1B and Unrestricted books were dropped.

benchmark_base_note: Regular-session closes on Fri Oct 2, 2026 (books restarted Sat Oct 3)
